one_liner: Open‑source Firebase alternative providing a hosted Postgres database with auto‑generated REST/GraphQL APIs, Auth, Storage, Realtime, Functions, and a Management API.
access_notes: Anyone can create a free org/project and obtain API keys; developers self‑serve PATs and create OAuth Apps in the dashboard.

evidence.quote: “OAuth2 allows your application to generate tokens on behalf of a Supabase user… Use this if you're building a third‑party app that needs to create or manage Supabase projects on behalf of your users.”

“Every request to your Supabase project carries an API key… Supabase is deprecating the anon and service_role keys by the end of 2026. Use the publishable (sb_publishable_…) and secret (sb_secret_…) keys instead.”
“Connect your AI tools using the official Supabase Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.”
“In your organization's settings, navigate to the OAuth Apps tab… click Add application.”
“Returns the PostgREST OpenAPI specification for the project.”
